purpose: Move from catalog coverage to an identifiable same-system pilot without inspecting gravity residuals or relaxing the three-dynamics-plus-three-lensing radial-overlap rule.

complete_baryonic_components_required: BCG total stellar light and mass-to-light nuisance
ICL treatment or explicit non-identifiability marginalization

frozen_candidate_sources: eleven Newman2013/Kaleidoscope2025 hosts with numerical velocity profiles
Loubser2018 hosts as acquisition candidates only until their figure-only profiles are reconstructed from raw spectra

stage_checkpoints.outcome: Produce a checksum/source-traceable gap ledger for every numerical-dynamics host and every promising Loubser strong-lens overlap, including exact radial support, covariance origin, baryonic components, and one primary obstruction.
stage_checkpoints.success: Every candidate has a disposition and at least three additional systems pass the frozen 3+3 structural gate, reducing the structural gap from eight to five or fewer.
stage_checkpoints.rethink: If one complete acquisition cycle adds fewer than two structural passes, stop broad catalog expansion and compare a pre-registered extended-kinematics route against a smaller identifiable pilot with a formal sample-size limitation.

stage_checkpoints.outcome: Bring at least two structural-pass systems through complete baryonic and covariance gates using raw-data reductions whose masks and nuisance models were frozen before residual inspection.
stage_checkpoints.success: At least two systems are strict R1-ready and a held-out forward prediction is defined for both dynamics and lensing.
stage_checkpoints.rethink: If neither MACS J1206 nor RX J2129 becomes strict-ready after its frozen raw-data protocol completes, do not repair thresholds post hoc; replace the failed system and record the failed gate.

stage_checkpoints.outcome: Freeze ten system identities, radial masks, covariance models, baryonic nuisance priors, and grouped validation splits before inspecting any gravity residual.
stage_checkpoints.success: Ten strict R1-ready systems with at least three common-support dynamical and lensing constraints each.
stage_checkpoints.rethink: After three acquisition cycles or seven active research days, whichever comes first, if fewer than ten systems are strict-ready, report the public-data identifiability ceiling and do not claim a ten-system unification test.

cycle_1_priority.action: Finish the already frozen two-ObsID Chandra reduction and preserve every failed calibration gate; define a fresh, thresholded blind lens-prediction split before any Weyl reconstruction.
cycle_1_priority.success: Calibrated gas likelihood passes its pre-registered checks and an unspent lens split meets a threshold frozen before fitting.
cycle_1_priority.failure: Retain as a structural-only system; do not infer a gravity response.

cycle_1_priority.action: Keep the failed level-2 pPXF consistency result paused unless genuinely new raw/calibration information arrives.
cycle_1_priority.success: A new independent data product passes the existing consistency protocol without threshold changes.
cycle_1_priority.failure: Replace rather than tune the reconstruction.

cycle_1_priority.action: Audit raw Gemini spectra and HST astrometric products because the nearest measured image is 15.4901 kpc, only 0.4901 kpc outside the published 15 kpc dynamics support.
cycle_1_priority.success: A frozen raw-spectra extraction yields at least three numerical dynamics bins with covariance whose verified support includes at least three independent lensing radii; a raw-image centroid covariance is derived independently of lens residuals.
cycle_1_priority.failure: Preserve the 0.4901 kpc near miss and do not expand the support after seeing a fit.

cycle_1_priority.action: Acquire a primary multiple-image catalog and audit it against the Loubser slit support before reconstructing any spectrum.
cycle_1_priority.success: At least three independently redshift-anchored measured images fall on verified dynamics support, authorizing a frozen raw-Gemini reconstruction.
cycle_1_priority.failure: Do not spend a dynamics reduction cycle on this host.

cycle_1_progress.Abell 1689: Primary Coe et al. image catalog passes the frozen 3+3 geometry screen with six images from six families on the 15-kpc support. All 17 program-associated GMOS files and ten matched biases are checksum-verified. Reduction remains closed until its detector, extraction, covariance, and acceptance protocol is frozen.
cycle_1_progress.RX J2129: The independently frozen two-ObsID Chandra reduction is still being processed; every calibration failure remains binding.
cycle_1_progress.MACS J1206: Paused after the frozen internal-consistency failure.
cycle_1_progress.Abell 2261: Retained as a 0.4901-kpc geometry near miss; the support will not be enlarged after inspection.
